basis: Illustrative annual activity at historical May horizons, not a current-year prediction. Shared carrier demand is partitioned, never duplicated. ID stock remains the inherited unthrottled N-squared assumption. Historical USD path is not a quote.
limitations: WORK revaluation, exact Q16 settlements, batch recipient distributions and endogenous feedback are not simulated.
Linked-publication envelopes, size mix and all new usage rates are assumptions, not measured costs or wallet quotes.
A model row does not enable capability, prove transaction admission or change any confirmed balance or record.
Jobs offered rewards add nothing; accepted payment behavior is covered only by existing shared carrier assumptions.
DNS owner self-payments and linked parts/linkers have no added scenario payment value. DNS trades appear only in AMO.
Standalone social payment estimates use direct owner payments; historical Boost registry wording is not current policy.

productCoverage.name: DNS
productCoverage.activity: Names, resolver updates, subdomains and verified page links
productCoverage.assumption: Illustrative DNS registrations, mutations and sale lifecycles have explicit demand and bytes. Subdomains/page links consume bytes but their owner self-payments add no new value.

productCoverage.name: Permission
productCoverage.activity: Wallet-authorized grants, replacements and revocations
productCoverage.assumption: 0.1 grant/replacement/revocation records per projected ID/year before inherited fee elasticity, capped by available Mail demand. Existing Mail value counts once; no Permission registry fee.

productCoverage.name: Jobs
productCoverage.activity: Briefs, proposals, assignments, delivery and accepted proof payments.
productCoverage.assumption: 0.1 illustrative job lifecycle per projected ID/year: four Mail records and one file delivery, capped by carrier demand. Offered rewards are not payments; no invented reward value is added.

productCoverage.name: Code
productCoverage.activity: Wallet-owned repositories and source revision records
productCoverage.assumption: Source and controls reuse existing carrier demand and payments once; only Code metadata adds bytes. Reads and downloads create no activity.
productCoverage.source: CODE.md; complete checkpoint-bound Code API observations

productCoverage.name: Publish
productCoverage.activity: Articles built from existing public content
productCoverage.assumption: One illustrative article per projected ID/year before inherited elasticity, capped by content demand; linked delivery moves to Files with the same assumed payment. 16,000-byte inline bodies and 1% at 4 MB are scenario assumptions, not measured publishing behavior.

productCoverage.name: Search
productCoverage.activity: Search projection of confirmed records
productCoverage.assumption: Discovery adds no payment or write to the indexed activity.

productCoverage.name: Home
productCoverage.activity: Landing page and apex redirect
productCoverage.assumption: Navigation creates no chain activity.

productCoverage.name: IDs

productCoverage.assumption: Identity stock and registry payments are separate components; registration bytes occur once.
productCoverage.source: PROOFOFWORK_IDS.md; confirmed registry and Growth summary

productCoverage.name: Computer

productCoverage.source: MAIL_ORGANIZATION.md; confirmed Mail/Files and Growth summary

productCoverage.assumption: Files, HTML pages, and tagged bonds are allocated to their specific lane; the ordinary Mail basket excludes those carriers.

productCoverage.activity: Computer workspace for non-HTML file publication and retrieval
productCoverage.assumption: General Files and Boost media include an illustrative 1% 4 MB linked-publication tail. Parts and linker add transactions/bytes, not another file payment. Code and Jobs retain their carrier-size assumptions.

productCoverage.name: Desktop
productCoverage.activity: Read-only access to existing Files and HTML records
productCoverage.assumption: Zero additional value or writes for displaying the same file.

productCoverage.assumption: Publish once in the Browser authoring basket; Mail/Drive and repeat views do not duplicate it.

productCoverage.assumption: Explicit alias of the existing one HTML publication per projected ID/year at 15,000 vB before inherited elasticity. Reading or linking the same page adds no second content payment.
